summary: Early Week 2 market watch. Game lines are available; no current player-prop line, price, availability and game-log package has been verified, so there are zero official plays.
takeaways: Detroit at Buffalo has the board's highest early total at 53.5. The first player-prop pass will test projected pass volume, route roles and weather only after exact prices are available.
Philadelphia at Tennessee has the lowest early total at 39.5. A lower total alone is not a prop edge; it is a reason to scrutinize team-play and touchdown assumptions.
Miami at San Francisco opened with San Francisco favored by 13.5. Any player case there must stress-test starter workload against blowout and late-game substitution risk.
